chunks: Sa'd ibn Sa'd asked Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام:
about a man who is with a menstruating woman in the mahmil: should he perform salat (prayer) while she is with him?

key_terms.الرِّضَا: al-Riḍā, the title of the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ: al-Hasan, part of the Imam's honorific title
key_terms.الْمَحْمِلِ: a covered mount or carrier used during travel

ai.seo_question: Can a man pray while a menstruating woman is with him in the same mahmil?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a man may perform salat (prayer) while a menstruating woman is with him in the same mahmil. It indicates that her state of hayd does not prevent the validity of his prayer merely due to proximity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1295 - Sa'd ibn Sa'd asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (as)

about a man who is with a menstruating woman in a mahmil (covered mount or carrier).
He asked: "Should he pray while She is with him?"
